items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: How did you meet J. Mayo Williams? I don’t know. I guess he met me first. “I want you to record.”

ctx.x: Because I have no reference to Decca recordings in the discography. But that’s one of the limitations of discographies too. How did you meet J. Mayo Williams?
I don’t know. I guess he met me first. “I want you to record.”
